configuration.title: Yuanmeng AI Dev Assistant
configuration.staleAfterMinutes: Minutes before a UI snapshot is marked stale.
configuration.uiRefreshTimeoutSeconds: Seconds to wait for the official command to update UI structure files.
configuration.propertyReadTimeoutSeconds: Seconds to wait for you to confirm the official component property panel and generate a CustomProperty file.
configuration.buildTimeoutSeconds: Seconds to wait for an official script build output update.
configuration.fileStableSampleMillisecon: Official UI structure file stability sample interval in milliseconds.
configuration.fileStableSampleCount: Consecutive stable samples required before reading official UI structure files.
configuration.enableRequestQueue: Allow the project-local controlled queue to accept read-only refresh-ui requests.
configuration.enableInternalLogAdapter: Read only redacted connection markers from the official Dream Helper output log in the current VS Code window; disable to stop reading it.
configuration.sceneStableSampleMilliseco: Scene data stability sample interval in milliseconds.
configuration.sceneStableSampleCount: Consecutive stable samples required before reading scene data.
configuration.sceneRefreshTimeoutSeconds: Seconds to wait for scene data to finish saving.
configuration.sceneCacheMaxCount: Latest private scene cache files retained per project. Snapshots referenced by current heads are always retained.
configuration.sceneCacheMaxAgeDays: Maximum age in days for private scene cache files. Snapshots referenced by current heads are always retained.
configuration.mcpToolProfile: MCP tool catalog: full preserves compatibility; workflow (recommended for daily AI development), scene, or gameplay exposes only the selected domain to reduce tool selection and context load.
configuration.gameInstallPath: Optional Yuanmeng game installation directory used only to read version text and static configuration filenames; account and network data are not read.
configuration.ugcDataPath: Optional UGC cache/project data directory used only to read usage ledgers, script archive names, and official resource indexes; map files are never modified.
configuration.officialExtensionPath: Set only when automatic official extension discovery is ambiguous.
configuration.eventsDocumentationPath: Optional local Events.md path used only to enrich callback parameters and runtime side; callable availability still comes from the installed official extension declarations.
configuration.resourceDocumentationPath: Optional local common-data-definition directory for official prop, image, audio, effect and item IDs; results retain document hashes and are never treated as scene instance IDs.
